items.title: Adopt new Rules and Regulations Restricting Potable Water Use for Irrigation of Nonfunctional Turf
items.text: Public hearing to consider and possible action to adopt new Rules and Regulations Restricting Potable Water Use for Irrigation of Nonfunctional Turf to align with Assembly Bill 1572; and authorize the General Manager in consultation with the City Attorney, to approve any non-substantive edits or minor corrections to the Rules and Regulations Restricting Potable Water Use for Irrigation of Nonfunctional Turf that are necessary or appropriate to facilitate implementation of Assembly Bill 1572. Pursuant to San Francisco Charter Section 4.104(a)(1), a Notice of Public Hearing was posted at the San Francisco Main Library and on the SFPUC’s website

items.title: Presentation and discussion of the Draft 2025 Urban Water Management Plan including the Draft 2025 Water Shortage Contingency Plan
items.text: Presentation and discussion only of the Draft 2025 Urban Water Management Plan, including the Draft 2025 Water Shortage Contingency Plan, prepared by the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission for the City and County of San Francisco pursuant to California Water Code Sections 10610-10657. The Commission will hold a second meeting to consider adoption of the final 2025 Urban Water Management Plan, following the public review and comment period on the Draft 2025 Urban Water Management Plan, no later than June 30, 2026. (Ritchie)
